name: Cable USB 3.0, Micro B sl/A, P

sources.title: Basler Cable USB 3.0, Micro B sl/A, P (Basler product documentation)
sources.covers: order numbers and lengths, transfer rates, connectors, cable diameter, minimum bending radius, bending cycles, drag-chain and robotics suitability, temperature

note: A passive USB 3.0 cable, Type A to Micro-B with screw lock, for ace and ace 2 cameras. Stated: "USB 3.0 5 Gbps" (stated_mbps 5000); cable diameter "6.2 mm max."; "Minimum Bending Radius 62 mm, fixed installation"; "Maximum Bending Cycles None (fixed installation only)" (flex_cycles null, min_bend_dynamic_mm null: not for moving use); "Suitable for Drag Chain Applications No", "Suitable for Robotics Applications No"; operating temperature "70 °C max., not moving". Lengths 1 m (2200000204), 3 m (2000033239), 5 m (2000033241); the 8 m version is a thicker cable (8 mm, 125 mm). Not stated: mass, whether it is active (active null).
